p.src: 1  Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

en: Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
u.src: 1  Listen now to what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

p.src: 2  Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

ja: を訴え、 イスラエルと争われるからだ。
en: Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
u.src: 2  Hear, you mountains, the LORD’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the LORD has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

p.src: 3  My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

ja: をしたのか。 どのようにあなたを
れさせたのか。 私に答えよ。
en: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
u.src: 3  My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

p.src: 4  For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

ja: 私はあなたをエジプトの
にモーセ、アロン、ミリアムを
en: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
u.src: 4  For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

p.src: 5  My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”

ja: い出せ。 シティムからギルガルまでのことを
en: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”
u.src: 5  My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD.”

p.src: 6  How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

ja: をかがめればよいのか。 全焼のささげ物を携え、
en: How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
u.src: 6  How shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

p.src: 7  Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

ja: ばれるだろうか。 私の
をささげるべきだろうか。
en: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
u.src: 7  Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

p.src: 8  He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

ja: が良いかは、すでにあなたに
し、 へりくだってあなたの
en: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
u.src: 8  He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

p.src: 9  The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

ja: に呼びかける。 御名を恐れることこそ
である。 「懲らしめの杖と、 それを
en: The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
u.src: 9  The LORD’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

p.src: 10  Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

ja: さなエパ があるのか。
en: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
u.src: 10  Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

ja: 6:10 一エパは約22リットル、または約3分の2ブッシェルである。「小さなエパ」とは、客を欺くために規定より小さく作られた升を指す。
en: 6:10 An ephah is a measure of volume (about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel), and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers.

p.src: 11  Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?

ja: な秤と、 欺きの重りを入れた袋を、私が容認するだろうか。
en: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?
u.src: 11  Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?

p.src: 12  Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

en: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

ち、重い傷を負わせ、 あなたの
en: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

p.src: 15  You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
